_comment: Every leaf of upstream's interface surface (conformance/upstream-surface.json, normalised by tools/conformance/check_coverage.py) classified as implemented / partial / not_applicable / todo. 'implemented' in this GUI means reachable from the UI, or delegated to upstream's own unchanged code. Excusing statuses carry a note. Group rules end in '*' and name the area they cover.

api.error_codes.*.note: Models screen not built yet; too_large_for_device needs a confirm-and-retry UI (retry_with.allow_oversized).

cli.install_flags.--allow-apt-install.note: A source build (no prebuilt llama.cpp for this host) can need apt packages; the GUI has no consent prompt for that yet, so such hosts get upstream's printed instructions in the log.

cli.install_flags.--backend.note: Set up passes --backend auto (upstream's own detection decides).

cli.install_flags.--build-timeout.note: Advanced/developer install option; GUI v1 takes upstream's default. The CLI shim upstream installs alongside remains available for these.

cli.install_flags.--gpu-layers.note: Advanced/developer install option; GUI v1 takes upstream's default. The CLI shim upstream installs alongside remains available for these.

cli.install_flags.--install-dir.note: Advanced/developer install option; GUI v1 takes upstream's default. The CLI shim upstream installs alongside remains available for these.

cli.install_flags.--jobs.note: Advanced/developer install option; GUI v1 takes upstream's default. The CLI shim upstream installs alongside remains available for these.

cli.install_flags.--model-hf.note: GUI v1 installs upstream's default model; choosing models belongs to the (todo) Models screen via pull.

cli.install_flags.--model-path.note: GUI v1 installs upstream's default model; choosing models belongs to the (todo) Models screen via pull.

cli.install_flags.--models-max.note: Advanced/developer install option; GUI v1 takes upstream's default. The CLI shim upstream installs alongside remains available for these.

cli.install_flags.--no-apt-install.note: The GUI never answers upstream's interactive apt prompt (stdin is closed), which upstream treats as 'no'.

cli.install_flags.--no-model-pull.note: GUI v1 installs upstream's default model; choosing models belongs to the (todo) Models screen via pull.

cli.install_flags.--no-service.note: Advanced/developer install option; GUI v1 takes upstream's default. The CLI shim upstream installs alongside remains available for these.

cli.install_flags.--no-source-build.note: Advanced/developer install option; GUI v1 takes upstream's default. The CLI shim upstream installs alongside remains available for these.

cli.install_flags.--no-start.note: Passed on hosts with no usable service manager; the GUI then hosts upstream's service payload itself.

cli.install_flags.--server-host.note: Advanced/developer install option; GUI v1 takes upstream's default. The CLI shim upstream installs alongside remains available for these.

cli.install_flags.--server-port.note: Advanced/developer install option; GUI v1 takes upstream's default. The CLI shim upstream installs alongside remains available for these.

cli.install_flags.--system.note: Advanced/developer install option; GUI v1 takes upstream's default. The CLI shim upstream installs alongside remains available for these.

cli.install_flags.--tag.note: Advanced/developer install option; GUI v1 takes upstream's default. The CLI shim upstream installs alongside remains available for these.

cli.install_flags.--verbose.note: Advanced/developer install option; GUI v1 takes upstream's default. The CLI shim upstream installs alongside remains available for these.

cli.install_flags.--via.note: Advanced/developer install option; GUI v1 takes upstream's default. The CLI shim upstream installs alongside remains available for these.

cli.shared_flags.--install-dir.note: GUI v1 uses upstream's default per-user layout only.

cli.shared_flags.--system.note: GUI v1 is per-user only (no elevation prompt).

cli.shared_flags.--verbose.note: Log verbosity; the GUI shows upstream's INFO output.

cli.subcommands.benchmark.*.note: Models screen not built yet; will use the HTTP equivalents (POST/GET/DELETE /models, POST /models/benchmark).

cli.subcommands.list.*.note: Models screen not built yet; will use the HTTP equivalents (POST/GET/DELETE /models, POST /models/benchmark).

cli.subcommands.login.flags.--credential.note: Pair button writes the clipboard/pasted JSON to a 0600 file and runs `cli login --credentials-file`.

cli.subcommands.login.flags.--tunnel-end.note: Scripting form of login; the GUI always uses --credentials-file so the secret never goes on argv.

cli.subcommands.login.flags.--tunnel-id.note: Scripting form of login; the GUI always uses --credentials-file so the secret never goes on argv.

cli.subcommands.login.flags.--tunnel-sec.note: Scripting form of login; the GUI always uses --credentials-file so the secret never goes on argv.

cli.subcommands.pull.*.note: Models screen not built yet; will use the HTTP equivalents (POST/GET/DELETE /models, POST /models/benchmark).

cli.subcommands.remove.*.note: Models screen not built yet; will use the HTTP equivalents (POST/GET/DELETE /models, POST /models/benchmark).

cli.subcommands.status.*.note: Status screen reads the same GET /status the CLI's `status` prints.

gui_hooks.layout_fields.*.note: gui_probe.py reads these from upstream's Layout.

gui_hooks.layout_functions.ensure_layout.note: Probe is read-only; only upstream's installer creates dirs.

gui_hooks.service_entry_flags.*.note: runtime.rs spawn_service passes --config-dir/--log-dir exactly like the systemd unit's ExecStart.

pins.dependencies.note: Upstream is stdlib-only, so the bare bundled interpreter runs it. A non-empty list here means the GUI must start bundling packages.

pins.llama_custom_builds.json.assets.*.note: Linux custom builds (e.g. Jetson) resolve through upstream's own build_cache.py.

pins.llama_custom_builds.json.tag.note: Lockstep by construction: the GUI bundles upstream's source at the pinned commit, so upstream's own fetch code and pin files are what run.

pins.newt_version.json.unverified_assets.note: Upstream's newt checksum for this platform is a placeholder, so pairing there fails until upstream fills it in. When it disappears from this list, that platform is unblocked.

pins.requires_python.note: Bundled python-build-standalone 3.12 (runtime/python_version.json); tests/test_bundled_python.py asserts it satisfies this.

runtime_config_keys.*.note: Delegated: only upstream code reads or writes runtime.json (installer, cli login/logout, service); gui_probe.py reads logged_in and llama_cpp.server_binary.

schema_version.note: Extractor schema version, not upstream surface.

service.default_models_max.note: Delegated: the GUI runs upstream's own code for this unchanged, so it matches by construction; any change still shows as drift.

service.default_port.note: service.rs SERVICE_BASE; asserted against this baseline by a Rust test.

service.fingerprint_version.note: Delegated: the GUI runs upstream's own code for this unchanged, so it matches by construction; any change still shows as drift.

service.login_gating.note: GUI screen flow (setup -> pair -> running) mirrors upstream's logged_in gate.

service.redaction_marker.note: The GUI never displays runtime_config.tunnel.secret, and never reads the secret back.

service.service_name.note: gui_probe.py asks upstream's service manager for this unit name.

service.status_keys.error.note: Keys of model/job API responses (the extractor gathers every _write_json in runner.py); used once the Models screen exists.

service.status_keys.job.note: Keys of model/job API responses (the extractor gathers every _write_json in runner.py); used once the Models screen exists.

service.status_keys.jobs.note: Keys of model/job API responses (the extractor gathers every _write_json in runner.py); used once the Models screen exists.

service.status_keys.runtime_params.note: Upstream's CLAUDE.md requires computed params be observable; the GUI should show them (with reasons) on the status screen.

service.status_keys.service.note: Constant service identity; nothing to show.

service.status_keys.status.note: Constant 'running'; the GUI uses /healthz for liveness.

tunnel.*.note: Delegated: upstream's own NewtSupervisor runs newt with upstream's pinned binary; the GUI only reads tunnel_connected from /status. Any change still shows as drift.
